product.name: Alchemy
product.description: An AI-powered business intelligence platform that connects and analyzes customer data to optimize marketing and media investments.

product.name: Advisory Services
product.description: Consulting services addressing complex organizational challenges including analytics, marketing transformation, and technology consulting.

product.name: Creative Services
product.description: Development of brand strategy, identity, integrated marketing campaigns, and production of creative content across multiple media.

product.name: CRM & Loyalty Programs
product.description: Design and management of customer relationship and loyalty programs to enhance brand engagement and customer retention.

product.name: Media Services
product.description: Data-driven media planning, buying, and optimization across national, local, programmatic, digital, and affiliate channels.

product.name: Data & Technology Solutions
product.description: Development of proprietary tools and technology solutions including data strategy, front-end development, SaaS enablement, and AI/ML model creation.
